channel.title: What It Can Become — The EcoCode Newsletter
channel.description: Milestones from the EcoCode platform, the Waste Intelligence Platform, and the Waste-to-Resource Knowledge Graph — each one linked to the thing itself.

item.title: Issue 001 — What it can become.
item.description: Everything the platform became in its first ten days on the open web: a site, a graph, a twin, and the machinery underneath. Ten days, five threads, thirteen milestones — from the GitHub Pages launch to the Pipeline Studio and the three data layers.
